SCRIPT.ENGLISH: You know why I’m doing this, right?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 你知道我为什么要找你谈话吗?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 你知道我爲什麼要找你談話嗎?
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: あんた、私が何で怒っているのか分かってるわよね？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Kamu tahu kenapa aku ngelakuin ini, kan?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Você sabe por que eu tô fazendo isso, né?
SCRIPT.RUSSIAN: Ты же знаешь, зачем я это делаю, да?
SCRIPT.FRENCH: Tu sais pourquoi je fais ça, hein ?
SCRIPT.THAI: นายก็รู้ใช่ไหมว่าฉันทำแบบนี้ทำไม?

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: ...Why are you doing this?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: …不知道!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: …不知道!
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: …何でよ
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: ...Kenapa kamu ngelakuin ini?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: ...Por que você tá fazendo isso?
SCRIPT.RUSSIAN: ...Почему ты это делаешь?
SCRIPT.FRENCH: ...Pourquoi tu fais ça ?
SCRIPT.THAI: ...ทำไมเธอทำแบบนี้ล่ะ?

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 언니한테도 이야기 안 하고 오면 어떡해!
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: How could you come back without telling me or even telling mom and dad?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 你怎么能不和我说一声就回来呢?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 你怎麼能不和我說一聲就回來呢?
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 私に何も言わずに帰って来るなんてどういうことよ！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Kok kamu bisa balik tanpa bilang sama aku atau bahkan sama mama dan papa?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Como você pôde voltar sem avisar pra mim ou mesmo pros nossos pais?
SCRIPT.RUSSIAN: Как ты могла вернуться, не сказав ни мне, ни даже маме с папой?
SCRIPT.FRENCH: Comment t’as pu revenir sans me prévenir, ni prévenir papa et maman ?
SCRIPT.THAI: เธอกลับมาโดยไม่บอกฉัน หรือแม้แต่พ่อแม่ได้ยังไง?

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Do they know?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 爸妈知道吗?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 爸媽知道嗎?
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: お母さんとお父さんは知ってるの？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Mereka tahu nggak?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Eles sabem?
SCRIPT.RUSSIAN: Они знают?
SCRIPT.FRENCH: Ils le savent ?
SCRIPT.THAI: พวกเขารู้หรือยัง?

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: So why are you here?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 所以你到底为什么回来?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 所以你到底爲什麼回來?
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: じゃあ、何で帰ってきたのよ。
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Jadi, kenapa kamu di sini?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Então, por que você tá aqui?
SCRIPT.RUSSIAN: Так зачем ты здесь?
SCRIPT.FRENCH: Alors pourquoi t’es là ?
SCRIPT.THAI: แล้วเธอมาที่นี่ทำไม?

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: To see Yuman oppa.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 我回来看吴宥万欧巴
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 我回來看吳宥萬歐巴
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: ユマンお兄ちゃんに会いたかったから。
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Untuk ketemu Yuman oppa.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Pra ver o Yuman oppa.
SCRIPT.RUSSIAN: Чтобы увидеть Юмана-оппу.
SCRIPT.FRENCH: Pour voir Oppa Yuman.
SCRIPT.THAI: ก็มาเจออปป้ายูมันไง.

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Me?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 看我?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 看我?
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 俺に？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Aku?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Eu?
SCRIPT.RUSSIAN: Меня?
SCRIPT.FRENCH: Moi ?
SCRIPT.THAI: ฉันเหรอ?

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Why are you here? You said you were friends.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 姐你又为什么会在这?不是说你俩只是朋友吗?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 姐你又爲什麼會在這?不是說你倆只是朋友嗎?
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: お姉ちゃんはなんでここにいるの？友達だって言ってたよね。
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Kenapa kamu di sini? Katanya kalian cuma teman.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Por que você tá aqui? Vocês disseram que eram só amigos.
SCRIPT.RUSSIAN: А ты зачем здесь? Вы ведь друзья, ты сама так говорила.
SCRIPT.FRENCH: Et toi, pourquoi t’es là ? Vous disiez que vous étiez juste amis.
SCRIPT.THAI: แล้วเธอมาที่นี่ทำไม? เธอบอกว่าเป็นแค่เพื่อนกันนี่.

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: I’m going to live here too!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 不管我要一起住在这!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 不管我要一起住在這!
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 私もここで一緒に住むんだから！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Aku juga mau tinggal di sini!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Eu também vou morar aqui!
SCRIPT.RUSSIAN: Я тоже собираюсь здесь жить!
SCRIPT.FRENCH: Moi aussi, je vais vivre ici !
SCRIPT.THAI: ฉันก็จะมาอยู่ที่นี่เหมือนกัน!

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: What do you mean by that, just showing up out of nowhere!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 你突然跑过来说什么胡话?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 你突然跑過來說什麼胡話?
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 急に来て、そんなこと言われても！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Apa maksudmu, tiba-tiba nongol kayak gini!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Como assim, você aparece do nada desse jeito!
SCRIPT.RUSSIAN: Что значит "жить"? Просто так взяла и появилась ниоткуда!
SCRIPT.FRENCH: Comment ça, vivre ici ? Tu débarques comme ça de nulle part !
SCRIPT.THAI: หมายความว่ายังไง อยู่ดี ๆ ก็โผล่มาแบบนี้!

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 나 어렸을 때부터 오빠랑 같이 사는 게 꿈이라 그랬잖아!
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: I’ve told you since I was a kid that my dream was to live with oppa!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 小的时候我的梦想就是和哥哥一起住啊!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 小的時候我的夢想就是和哥哥一起住啊!
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 私、昔からお兄ちゃんと一緒に住むのが夢だったって言ったでしょ！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Dari kecil aku udah bilang kalau impianku itu tinggal bareng oppa!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Desde criança eu já dizia que meu sonho era morar com o oppa!
SCRIPT.RUSSIAN: Я же с детства говорила, что моя мечта — жить с оппой!
SCRIPT.FRENCH: Depuis que je suis petite, je dis que mon rêve, c’est de vivre avec Oppa !
SCRIPT.THAI: ฉันบอกตั้งแต่เด็กแล้วว่าฝันอยากอยู่กับอปป้า!

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 그게 언제 적인데. 너 지금 성인이잖아!
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: That was ages ago. You’re an adult now!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 那是小时候，你现在已经是成年人了!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 那是小時候，你現在已經是成年人了!
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: それ、いつの話だよ。今、もう大人なんだから！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Itu udah lama banget. Sekarang kamu udah dewasa!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Isso foi há muito tempo. Agora você é adulta!
SCRIPT.RUSSIAN: Это было сто лет назад! Ты теперь взрослая!
SCRIPT.FRENCH: C’était y a des années ! Maintenant t’es adulte !
SCRIPT.THAI: นั่นมันนานมาแล้วนะ ตอนนี้เธอโตแล้ว!

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Exactly~ I’m an adult!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 没错!我现在是成年人!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 沒錯!我現在是成年人!
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: そうだよ～私はもう大人だもん！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Persis~ Aku udah dewasa!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Exatamente~ Eu sou adulta!
SCRIPT.RUSSIAN: Вот именно~ Я теперь взрослая!
SCRIPT.FRENCH: Exactement~ Maintenant, je suis adulte !
SCRIPT.THAI: ใช่เลย~ ตอนนี้ฉันเป็นผู้ใหญ่แล้ว!

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 나 이제 언니보다 가슴도 크고 엉덩이도 커!
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: I’m bigger than you now, both in chest and butt!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 我现在胸比你还挺，屁股比你还翘!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 我現在胸比你還挺，屁股比你還翹!
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 今はもう、お姉ちゃんより胸も大きいし、ヒップも大きいんだから！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Sekarang aku lebih gede dari kamu, baik di dada maupun bokong!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Agora eu sou maior que você, tanto no peito quanto no bumbum!
SCRIPT.RUSSIAN: Я уже больше тебя — и в груди, и в попе!
SCRIPT.FRENCH: J’ai même plus de seins et de fesses que toi !
SCRIPT.THAI: หน้าอกกับสะโพกฉันใหญ่กว่าของเธอด้วย!

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Hey, Go Eunbi!!! Do you want to die?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 喂!高恩妃!我看你是活腻了!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 喂!高恩妃!我看你是活膩了!
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: ちょっと、あんた！！！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Hei, Go Eun-bi!!! Mau mati, ya?!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Ei, Go Eun-bi!!! Quer morrer, é?!
SCRIPT.RUSSIAN: Эй, Го Ынби!!! Ты жить надоела?!
SCRIPT.FRENCH: Hé, Go Eunbi !!! Tu veux mourir ou quoi ?!
SCRIPT.THAI: เฮ้! โก อึนบี!!! อยากตายรึไง?!

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Hey, don’t fight when you haven’t seen each other in so long...
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 这么久没见你俩就别吵了…
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 這麼久沒見你倆就別吵了…
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 二人とも久しぶりに会ったんだから、ケンカするなよ…
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Hei, jangan ribut gitu, kan kalian udah lama nggak ketemu...
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Ei, não briguem, vocês não se viam fazia tanto tempo...
SCRIPT.RUSSIAN: Эй, не ссорьтесь, вы ведь давно не виделись...
SCRIPT.FRENCH: Hé, vous venez de vous retrouver, alors arrêtez de vous battre...
SCRIPT.THAI: พอเลย พวกเธอเพิ่งได้เจอกัน อย่าทะเลาะกันสิ...

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Why?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 怎么?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 怎麼?
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 何で？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Kenapa?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Por quê?
SCRIPT.RUSSIAN: Почему?
SCRIPT.FRENCH: Pourquoi ?
SCRIPT.THAI: ทำไมล่ะ?

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Do you see Eunbi as a woman now that it’s been a while?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 这么久没见，她现在对你来说是个女人了?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 這麼久沒見，她現在對你來說是個女人了?
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 久しぶりにウンビ見たら、女っぽくなった？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Apa sekarang kamu lihat Eun-bi sebagai wanita karena udah lama nggak ketemu?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Agora você tá vendo a Eun-bi como mulher porque faz tempo que não se encontram?
SCRIPT.RUSSIAN: Ты видишь в Ынби женщину теперь, когда столько времени прошло?
SCRIPT.FRENCH: Tu commences à voir Eunbi comme une femme maintenant que ça fait un moment ?
SCRIPT.THAI: หรือว่านายมองอึนบีเป็นผู้หญิงหลังจากไม่ได้เจอกันนาน?

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: No, it’s not like that...
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 我不是那个意思…
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 我不是那個意思…
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: いや、そういうわけじゃなくて…
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Bukan gitu maksudnya...
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Não é bem isso...
SCRIPT.RUSSIAN: Нет, это не так...
SCRIPT.FRENCH: Non, c’est pas ça...
SCRIPT.THAI: ไม่ใช่แบบนั้น...

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 넌 그리고 우유만이 왜 아직도 좋아?
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: And why do you still like Yuman?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 还有，你怎么到现在还喜欢宥万啊?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 還有，你怎麼到現在還喜歡宥萬啊?
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: あんた、何でまだユマンのことが好きなのよ。
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Terus, kenapa kamu masih suka sama Yuman?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Então por que você ainda gosta do Yuman?
SCRIPT.RUSSIAN: И почему ты всё ещё любишь Юмана?
SCRIPT.FRENCH: Et pourquoi t’aimes toujours Yuman ?
SCRIPT.THAI: แล้วทำไมเธอยังชอบยูมันอยู่?

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Look at his face.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 你看看这张脸
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 你看看這張臉
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: こいつの顔、見てみなよ。
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Liat deh mukanya.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Olha pra cara dele.
SCRIPT.RUSSIAN: Посмотри на его лицо.
SCRIPT.FRENCH: Regarde son visage.
SCRIPT.THAI: ดูหน้าหมอนั่นสิ.

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: It’s a total mess!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 长得乱七八糟的!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 長得亂七八糟的!
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: ブサイクじゃん！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Berantakan banget!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Tá toda bagunçada!
SCRIPT.RUSSIAN: У него же полный бардак!
SCRIPT.FRENCH: C’est une vraie catastrophe !
SCRIPT.THAI: เละเทะไปหมด!

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: I like it! His scruffy look is cute!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 那我也喜欢!丑丑的才可爱
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 那我也喜歡!醜醜的纔可愛
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: それがいいの！可愛いんじゃん！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Aku suka! Tampangnya yang awut-awutan itu imut!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Eu gosto! Esse jeitinho largado dele é fofo!
SCRIPT.RUSSIAN: Мне нравится! Он милый с этой небритостью!
SCRIPT.FRENCH: Moi, j’aime bien ! Son côté négligé est mignon !
SCRIPT.THAI: แต่ฉันชอบนะ! ลุคเซอร์ ๆ ของเขาน่ารักดี!

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 내가 언니보다 오빠에 대해 더 많이 알걸!
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: I bet I know more about oppa than you do!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 而且我比你更了解宥万哥哥!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 而且我比你更瞭解宥萬哥哥!
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 私、お姉ちゃんよりお兄ちゃんのこと、詳しいんだから！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Aku yakin aku lebih tahu soal oppa daripada kamu!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Aposto que eu sei mais sobre o oppa do que você!
SCRIPT.RUSSIAN: Я уверена, что знаю об оппе больше, чем ты!
SCRIPT.FRENCH: Je parie que je connais Oppa mieux que toi !
SCRIPT.THAI: ฉันรู้จักอปป้ามากกว่าเธอแน่นอน!

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 오빠도 언니보다 나에 대해 더 많이 알 거야.
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: And oppa knows more about me than he does about you.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 哥哥也比你更了解我
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 哥哥也比你更瞭解我
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: お兄ちゃんだって、お姉ちゃんより私のこと、詳しいわよね？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Dan oppa juga lebih tahu tentang aku daripada tentang kamu.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: E o oppa sabe mais sobre mim do que sobre você.
SCRIPT.RUSSIAN: И оппа знает обо мне больше, чем о тебе.
SCRIPT.FRENCH: Et Oppa me connaît mieux que toi.
SCRIPT.THAI: แล้วอปป้าก็รู้จักฉันดีกว่าเธอด้วย.

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Oppa!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 哥哥!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 哥哥!
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: お兄ちゃん！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Oppa!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Oppa!
SCRIPT.RUSSIAN: Оппа!
SCRIPT.FRENCH: Oppa !
SCRIPT.THAI: อปป้า!

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Remember how you always teased me
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 你还记得小时候
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 你還記得小時候
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 子供の頃、いつも
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Ingat nggak dulu kamu sering ngeledek aku
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Lembra de como você sempre me zoava
SCRIPT.RUSSIAN: Помнишь, как ты дразнил меня в детстве
SCRIPT.FRENCH: Tu te souviens quand tu te moquais de moi
SCRIPT.THAI: จำได้ไหมว่านายเคยล้อฉันเรื่อง

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 내 점 가지고 놀린 거 기억나지?
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: About my mole when we were kids?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 你总拿我的痣开玩笑吗?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 你總拿我的痣開玩笑嗎?
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 私のホクロのこと、からかってたの覚えてるでしょ？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Soal tahi lalatku waktu kita kecil?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Por causa da minha pinta quando a gente era criança?
SCRIPT.RUSSIAN: из-за моей родинки?
SCRIPT.FRENCH: à cause de mon grain de beauté quand on était petits ?
SCRIPT.THAI: ไฝของฉันตอนเด็ก ๆ?

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Do you remember where it is?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 那个痣在哪你还记得吗?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 那個痣在哪你還記得嗎?
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: そのホクロ、どこにあるのか覚えてる？
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Kamu masih ingat di mana tahi lalat itu?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Você ainda lembra onde ela fica?
SCRIPT.RUSSIAN: Помнишь, где она?
SCRIPT.FRENCH: Tu te rappelles où il est ?
SCRIPT.THAI: นายจำได้ไหมว่าไฝฉันอยู่ตรงไหน?
